title: native private-use redirect
means: A native client may use a claimed https URI, an http loopback URI on exactly localhost , 127.0.0.1 , or [::1] with any port, or an authority-free private-use URI with a reverse-domain scheme such as com.example.app:/callback

title: reserved native URI scheme
means: Better Auth also rejects credentials, fragments, malformed or reserved schemes such as file: and mailto:

title: Basic client authentication
means: client_secret_basic — Client credentials sent via HTTP Basic Auth header (default)

title: unsupported grant
means: The authorization grant type is not supported by the authorization server.

title: consent-dependent authorization
means: Consent is required on all non-trusted clients, specifically those without skip_consent
